files_summary.memory_graph.json: Rich AI-research-lab knowledge graph: people, orgs, projects, papers, technologies, locations, events with multi-hop relations.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: memory_create_entities
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple entities in Lattice Recall Graph Service with their entityType and initial observations, and returns the entities that were created (or an equivalent acknowledgement of what was stored). Refuses requests where the entities list is missing/empty, any entity is missing required fields (name, entityType, observations), or values are the wrong type. Refuses creation when an entity name conflicts with an existing entity (names must be unique) or when an entity’s observations are not provided as an array of strings.

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

tool_schemas.name: memory_create_relations
tool_schemas.description: Creates multiple directed relations (from → to) between existing entities and returns the relations that were added (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where the relations list is missing/empty, any relation is missing from/to/relationType, or values are the wrong type. Refuses relations that reference entities that do not exist, or that would duplicate an identical existing relation (same from, to, and relationType).

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

tool_schemas.name: memory_add_observations
tool_schemas.description: Appends one or more new observation strings to existing entities and returns the updated entities (or an equivalent acknowledgement of what was appended). Refuses requests where the observations list is missing/empty, any item is missing entityName or contents, or contents is not an array of strings. Refuses additions for entity names that do not exist, and refuses observation entries that are not valid strings.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to add the observations to

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add

tool_schemas.name: memory_delete_entities
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the named entities and any relations connected to them, and returns what was deleted (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where entityNames is missing/empty or contains non-string values. Refuses deletion for entity names that do not exist.

entityNames.description: An array of entity names to delete

tool_schemas.name: memory_delete_observations
tool_schemas.description: Deletes specific observation strings from the specified entities and returns what was removed (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where deletions is missing/empty, any item is missing entityName or observations, or observations is not an array of strings. Refuses deletions for entity names that do not exist, and refuses observation removals when the specified observation text is not present on that entity.

entityName.description: The name of the entity containing the observations

observations.description: An array of observations to delete

tool_schemas.name: memory_delete_relations
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified relations and returns what was removed (or an equivalent acknowledgement). Refuses requests where relations is missing/empty, any relation is missing from/to/relationType, or values are the wrong type. Refuses deletion when the referenced relation does not exist (no exact match for from, to, and relationType), or when from/to refer to unknown entities.

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

relations.description: An array of relations to delete

tool_schemas.name: memory_read_graph
tool_schemas.description: Returns the complete knowledge graph, including all entities, their observations, and relations between them. Refuses requests with unexpected parameters that are not supported by this endpoint. Refuses access when the caller is not permitted to read the graph.

tool_schemas.name: memory_search_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Searches the graph for entities matching the query against entity names, entity types, and observation text, and returns the matching nodes (and any directly relevant details the service includes). Refuses requests where query is missing, not a string, or is empty/whitespace-only. Refuses access when the caller is not permitted to search the graph.

query.description: The search query to match against entity names, types, and observation content

tool_schemas.name: memory_open_nodes
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the entities for the provided names and returns the matching nodes with their stored details. Refuses requests where names is missing/empty or contains non-string values. Refuses any names that do not correspond to an existing entity, and refuses access when the caller is not permitted to read those nodes.

names.description: An array of entity names to retrieve

metadata.name: Lattice Recall Graph Service
metadata.description: Stores and queries a lightweight entity-relationship knowledge graph, letting users create and manage entities, relations, and freeform observations for fast lookup and exploration.
